asr.full_text: Hey Prepsters, welcome to our new video. So in this video we will discuss the most important topics and recruitment pattern for IBM. So this video will cover everything you need to know about their written test pattern, their most important topics and their interview process. So let's get started. And also we are going to upload hundreds of videos for your placement readiness and placement preparation journey. So please subscribe to our channel and click on the bell icon to get all the notifications. Now talking about the pre-placement talk. So the HR of the company will connect with all of the candidates to discuss about the company, the job roles, the salary, their compensations and company culture. So after that you will be having a Q&A round for the students, that means you can put up questions in front of them regarding all the recruitment procedure. Now coming to the written test pattern, there are two profiles offered by IBM. These are Global Technological services and global business services. So for these two jobs, there are different retentate pattern, which we will discuss in the next video itself. Now coming to the interview process. So there's only one interview for both HR and technical role. So only one person will take care both HR plus technical interview. only 1% will take care of both HR and technical interview now coming to the offer roll out so within a week span IBM will roll it's offer letters & now coming to the salary so this salary range is 2.74 LPA to 4.27 LPA ranging from college to college now talking about the overview. so let's do talk about the GBS Profile, so the sections are Quantitative Aptitude, Business communication test and number series And for the GTS profile the sections are Quantitative aptitude, Work style personality test so this is the difference between GBS and GTS. So now, talking about the qunatative aptitude section, so it is there for between GBS and GTS. Now talking about the quantitative aptitude section. This is there for both GTS and GBS profile so it'll have around 18 questions and it'll be off 38 mins. So the main topics will be Profit & Loss, Permutation & Combinatio, Percentages, Probability, etc, And other things that you can refer in table itself. So coming to the logical ability- So its only there for the gfs profile- So it has only one topic which is the number series, and you have to prepare well for it, it will have around 18 questions and it will be of the 38 minutes. Now coming to the business communication test. So its only there for the GBS profile as mentioned so it will provide around 22 questions questions will have around 20 minutes to solve. The main topics will be, Active and Passive, Synonyms and Anonyms, fill in the blanks and Efficient Email Writing MCQ Questions Efficient email writing MCQ questions if the toughest of all and you really need to prepare well for it so we take good care of it in our online classes now talking about the work style personality test so it's only for the gts profile and it's kind of a psychological ability test so obviously there are no right or wrong answers, so basically you'll be having around 100 questions and I guess you will be able to do it in 20 minutes so its really no difficult psychological questions will be put in front of you, so thats it. Now talking about our online classes, we focus on email writing& personality test in depth. So 84 percent of of students who take our online classes get selected in IBM placements so if you want to be in the top percent I'll holder so please go to our classes now coming to the interview round so as I've told you both HR as well as the technical down will be covered in the same interview so that will happen in the same bow and the interview panel consists of only one person. So coming to the technical round he may put up questions in front of you regarding C, C++, Jerva, databases and data structures. And in HR he can ask you questions regarding your personality, your family, your work experience If relevant And educational Your internships And many other things So you really need to brush up your coding skills And your final year project Because IBM tends to Ask questions from your coding As well as your theory So mug it up all Now coming to the results So generally the results Are given out in 7-14 days And the offer So, the offer validity and joining letter is only given after the background check is complete for your authenticity, criminal history, eligibility criteria, and timely completion of your degree, your eligibility criteria and your timely completion of your degree. I hope to see you really helpful. Please check all the other IBM videos in the descriptions box below. Also subscribe to our channel as we are going to upload many videos on placement preparation journey. Also feel free to ask questions in the comment section below! We are also rolling out discount coupons valid only for our youtube viewers for both online classes and smart material subscription.
